Hi, I'm a portfolio manager preparing for our risk committee board meeting next week. I have a raw export from our custody system saved at `workspace/client_data/raw/portfolio_export_custody.json` — it's a bit messy from the export tool, so it may need some cleanup before it can be used. 

I need you to run a full risk analysis on this book using SPY as the benchmark, then give me a clean one-page summary of the most critical findings saved as `risk_summary.md`. The summary should cover the key risk numbers, how we'd fare in a major market crisis, whether we're too concentrated anywhere, and any concrete recommendations we should bring to the committee. 

Please make sure the summary uses the actual numbers from the analysis, not just generic commentary.
